what_this_is: ONE cold-start interview walked down Paper B's cold tree, in which every question at a C1-final EMITTING state is the policy's own off-catalogue direction rendered into English, shown beside the catalogue question the tree would have asked at that state
figure_rule: a state outside C1-final's 57 trained states gets NO synthesised question: the row prints the tree's own question and is marked '[no emission -- outside the fitted set]'

walk.branching: ndcg_tree.branch_of -- the tree's OWN behavioural three-way rule, decided BEFORE the circular answer model is installed

emission_source.per_state_vector: the COHORT MEAN of z_hat at that state. C1-final measures within-state per-user agreement at 0.99991, so the emitted point at a state is one object, not an average over disagreeing users. C1-final banks no policy checkpoint, so re-emitting is not possible and this is the only available object.

space.why_this_is_a_flag: C1-final's policy is Paper B's m7dj warm start, so its emissions live in m7dj's k(phi) space; the C3B adapter was trained on E1's k(phi) space. Both are 128-d over the SAME frozen phi, but they are two learned read-outs and nothing guarantees a shared basis. See `probe`.

direct.construction: the emission's own k(phi) vector, standardised by m7dj's OWN bank mean and global scale (so its LENGTH is in the adapter's units even though its BASIS is m7dj's)

lstsq.construction: the emission's SCORE PROFILE over the 19,390-entry bank (z_hat . e_q, the quantity the policy's own argmax reads) re-expressed in the adapter's space by ridge-stabilised least squares, standardised, then rescaled to the emission's own relative mean-removed norm
lstsq.r2_note: a low R^2 is a REASON NOT TO USE THIS ROW, not a number to quote

target.construction: the state's m=5 measured-gain blend rebuilt out of the ADAPTER'S OWN bank rows -- no cross-space bridge exists in this row
target.renders: the state's BLEND TARGET, not the policy's emission (labelled in every row)

bestofk_lm.note: SECONDARY: k=8 samples, argmax LENGTH-NORMALISED LM sequence log-likelihood. The picker never sees the tower, the cosine, R_s or any evaluation quantity.

renderer.decoding_of_record: C4C_DECODING.md ruling 1: best-of-8 by LENGTH-NORMALISED LM likelihood, a pick rule blind to every evaluation quantity. Ruling 2: greedy is shown beside it, because the variance is real.

answer_model.rule: answer(r, c) = sign(u*_r . d_c), +-1, refusal never simulated
answer_model.u_star: fold_items_frozen(ctx.enc, ctx.allb[r]) -- the env's own full fold-in profile latent, identical in construction to answer_contrast.u_star
answer_model.note: the certified fold's cap_negatives over the REVEALED set still applies, so a user answering k of the 4 concepts negatively folds them at -min(1, c_neg/k) rather than -1. It is the env's own certified operator and it is applied identically in all four arms.
answer_model.label: under a declared-circular answer model

declared_choices.branch_behavioural_fold_circular: BRANCHING uses the tree's behavioural answers (so the walk is the tree's real walk); FOLDING and SCORING use the declared-circular model, because a synthesised off-catalogue question has no behavioural answer table entry and refusal is never simulated. Both columns get the identical treatment, so the choice cannot move the comparison; it is declared here, in the spec and in the caption.
declared_choices.cumulative_fold: the belief updates turn by turn: turn t folds everything asked up to t, concepts ascending by id within a turn (c4b_noise's ask order). Each turn is scored on the cohort standing at THAT node, against that same cohort's own m=0 base.
declared_choices.top5_display: the top-5 lists are the cohort MEAN of the decoder score, unmasked -- a DISPLAY object. Every NDCG number comes from genv_eval under the certified contract and none comes from the display path.
declared_choices.cohort: the whole 10,000-user validation cohort unless --n_users names a leading slice, which is then declared here and in the figure caption

reference.definition: R_s = sum_j w_j * tower(q_j) over the state's banked m=5 ingredients (c4_pilot.reference_directions, IMPORTED)

disclosure.note: Ew rows carry their own magnitude, d_c rows are unit -- so in a mixed blend the nominal weight is not the effective one. Reported, not corrected: R_s is defined by the sheet in exactly these two objects.

what_may_not_be_claimed: NO VALUE CLAIM: every NDCG row runs under a declared-circular answer model and carries at most a RELATIVE reading (AUTHOR RULING 2026-08-25) - nothing at states outside C1-final's 57 - nothing about the item channel - not that the questions are good because they read well - not that a human would answer them
